front: Shake an enemy's resolve with a shout or taunt to frighten it, using Intimidation against its Will DC.
back:
Target a creature you're aware of within 30 ft. Intimidation vs. Will DC. -4 circumstance penalty if it doesn't understand your language. Target is then immune to your Demoralize for 10 minutes, regardless of result.
Crit Success: frightened 2.
Success: frightened 1.
